coverage: Reviewed common-boss subset; item IDs checked against RuneLite 1.13.1. Positive ownership only; ammunition, charges, wielding levels, spells and supplies remain separate unverified facts. Task overlays are local soft planning heuristics; alternatives are accepted without a best-in-slot grind requirement.

capabilities.label: Basic ranged weapon
capabilities.description: Observed magic shortbow or rune crossbow ownership. Ammunition, charges and wielding levels are not verified.

capabilities.label: Bow of Faerdhinen
capabilities.description: Observed active/corrupted Bowfa variant. Charges and wielding levels need a separate check; inactive and Gauntlet weapons are excluded.

capabilities.label: Crystal helm
capabilities.description: Active crystal helm ownership; beta, inactive and Gauntlet variants are excluded. Remaining armour charges are unknown.

capabilities.label: Crystal body
capabilities.description: Active crystal body ownership; beta, inactive and Gauntlet variants are excluded. Remaining armour charges are unknown.

capabilities.label: Crystal legs
capabilities.description: Active crystal legs ownership; beta, inactive and Gauntlet variants are excluded. Remaining armour charges are unknown.

capabilities.label: Full crystal armour
capabilities.description: Full helm, body and legs ownership, regardless of where they are observed. Owning this does not mean the full set is equipped.

capabilities.label: Bowfa with full crystal
capabilities.description: Bowfa and full crystal armour ownership together. This is a supported kit, not a guarantee of a particular DPS or task time.

capabilities.label: Twisted bow
capabilities.description: Observed standard Twisted bow ownership. Target-dependent damage, ammunition and wielding levels are not modelled.

capabilities.label: Ranged accuracy kit
capabilities.description: Supported ranged preparation alternatives: Bowfa with full crystal, or Twisted bow. The task recommendation is a local heuristic; other successful loadouts remain possible.

capabilities.label: Ratbane weapon
capabilities.description: Bone mace, bone shortbow or bone staff ownership. Any of the three supports ratbane preparation; weapon style, charges and skill readiness are separate.

capabilities.label: Powered magic weapon
capabilities.description: Observed charged-form trident, Sanguinesti staff, Tumeken's shadow or warped sceptre ownership. Uncharged forms are excluded. Remaining charges, wielding levels and ammunition remain unverified; recognition establishes ownership of a supported weapon only.

capabilities.label: Supported crossbow
capabilities.description: Rune, dragon, Armadyl, dragon hunter or Zaryte crossbow ownership. Unfinished, beta and LMS forms are excluded. Bolts and wielding levels require a separate check.

capabilities.label: Toxic blowpipe
capabilities.description: Charged-form Toxic blowpipe ownership. The empty form is excluded; darts, scales and remaining charges are not verified.

capabilities.label: Crystal bow
capabilities.description: Active standard Crystal bow ownership, including legacy partial-charge forms. Inactive, Gauntlet and beta weapons are excluded. Remaining charges are unknown.

capabilities.label: Iban's staff
capabilities.description: Regular or upgraded Iban's staff ownership, including supported ornamented forms. Iban Blast access, runes and remaining charges are not verified.

capabilities.label: Elemental casting staff
capabilities.description: Basic air, water, earth or fire staff ownership. The selected spell, spellbook, runes, skill level and damage are unknown.

capabilities.label: Supported melee weapon
capabilities.description: Common melee alternatives: dragon scimitar/sword/mace, whip/tentacle, zombie axe, cudgel, bludgeon, hasta, rapier, fang, lance or noxious halberd. Ownership does not verify skill levels, durability, attack style or a complete armour loadout.

capabilities.label: Supported crush weapon
capabilities.description: Common crush-style alternatives: dragon mace, Zamorakian hasta, Abyssal bludgeon, leaf-bladed battleaxe, Sarachnis cudgel, Inquisitor's mace, zombie axe or dual macuahuitl. Selected attack style and wielding readiness are unverified.

capabilities.label: Supported stab weapon
capabilities.description: Dragon sword, Zamorakian hasta, Ghrazi rapier, dragon hunter lance or Osmumten's fang ownership. This is a budget-inclusive group; a dragonbane weapon is optional. Selected attack style and wielding readiness are unverified.

capabilities.label: Black or Tecu salamander
capabilities.description: Black or Tecu salamander ownership. Ammunition, selected style and wielding levels are unknown; weaker salamanders remain an unclassified alternative.

capabilities.label: Supported ranged weapon
capabilities.description: Budget-inclusive ranged alternatives: a supported shortbow/crossbow, active Crystal bow, Toxic blowpipe, Bowfa or Twisted bow. Armour, ammunition and levels still need checking.

capabilities.label: Supported magic weapon
capabilities.description: A powered weapon, Iban's staff or elemental casting staff supports this soft recommendation. It does not verify a usable spell, charges, spellbook, runes or armour.

capabilities.label: Barrows combat alternative
capabilities.description: Soft weapon preparation may use melee, ranged, magic or a black/Tecu salamander. These broad alternatives deliberately do not require one expensive weapon; task-specific restrictions still apply.

capabilities.label: Ranged or magic alternative
capabilities.description: Ranged or magic weapon ownership as a soft preparation option for distance-based tasks. This is not proof that the particular task condition or range requirement is satisfied.

capabilities.label: Vorkath weapon alternative
capabilities.description: Soft alternatives for unrestricted Vorkath tasks: supported stab weapon, crossbow or Toxic blowpipe. Dragonbane ownership is optional. Dragonfire/venom protection, ammunition and spawn handling must be checked separately.

capabilities.label: Sarachnis weapon alternative
capabilities.description: Common soft preparation alternatives: crush melee, ranged or magic. No particular cudgel, axe or best-in-slot item is required by this recommendation; task-specific restrictions remain separate.

capabilities.label: Dagannoth three-style weapons
capabilities.description: Compound soft preparation for the three-king task: one supported melee, ranged and magic weapon together. Individual-king tasks recommend only their respective style. Weapon ownership does not verify all fight conditions.

capabilities.label: GWD combat alternative
capabilities.description: Soft melee, ranged or magic weapon alternatives for unrestricted Graardor tasks. This acknowledges alternate methods without choosing best-in-slot gear; access items, supplies and attack restrictions remain unverified.

capabilities.label: Melee or ranged alternative
capabilities.description: Soft melee or ranged weapon alternatives. Other successful methods remain possible; this grouping makes no hard access, damage or speed claim.
